focus: Verify the ai-council external-cli dispatch finding and the max-iterations post-dispatch finding with path:line and a command each

graphEvents.label: Does ai-council external-cli have a dispatch runtime?
Does a missing per-lineage cap fail before or after dispatch?

label: FALSIFIED: ai-council external-cli has a dispatch runtime. dispatchSeat is defined at orchestrate-session.cjs:359 and injected into runtimeExecutorConfig at :791; the sole non-test caller of dispatchCouncilSeats (divergent-pivot.ts:1524) supplies dispatchSeat and throws without it.

NARROWED: executor.mode is inert. No non-test script reads it or the string external-cli; the only source hit is the contract compiler's field list (compile-command-contracts.cjs:110). dispatchSeat always calls runSeatSubprocess (orchestrate-session.cjs:389), so in-cli and external-cli behave identically unless a model-authored step supplies its own dispatchSeat.

CONFIRMED: a fan-out with stopPolicy=max-iterations and no per-lineage cap is rejected only after the lineage runs. The violation is returned by findMaxIterationsPolicyViolation (fanout-run.cjs:1133) at its sole production call site inside the post-result handler (:4036) and thrown at :4101; the argv builder still dispatches with the default cap of 12 (:1759), so every lineage burns a full run before failing.

The covering unit test exists and passes (19 passed, 154 skipped, exit 0) but asserts the pure function only, never its ordering relative to lineage dispatch, so the post-dispatch defect can regress green.

Probe error: rg -rn treats -r as a replacement flag and rewrote every dispatchSeat match to the literal n; results were discarded and the search re-run without -r. Method note: never pass -r to rg for line-number listing.

direction: ai-council external-cli mode has no dispatch runtime
reason: Falsified by orchestrate-session.cjs:359/:791 and multi-seat-dispatch.cjs:140; the surviving defect is the inert executor.mode flag, not a missing dispatcher.
